manifest.adaptation: Original B5 v1 paradigm adapted explicitly to source v3 69 observations/20 actions; not exact 1.7B reproduction.
manifest.system_prompt:
You are controlling an NPC in a life simulation game. Choose the single best action number (0-19) for its persona and current needs. Output only the action number and nothing else. All listed actions are legal; need restoration applies anywhere. Need levels range from 0 to 1, with levels below 0.2 critical. Time is normalized by 23; positions by 11; previous action numbers by 19.
Actions:
0: focused_work; restores work by 0.05
1: planning_work; restores work by 0.05
2: eat_quick; restores hunger by 0.05
3: eat_slow; restores hunger by 0.08
4: sleep; restores sleep by 0.1
5: nap; restores sleep by 0.05
6: socialize_initiate; restores social by 0.07
7: socialize_respond; restores social by 0.07
8: exercise_intense; restores fitness by 0.08
9: exercise_light; restores fitness by 0.04
10: read_deep; restores learning by 0.06
11: read_casual; restores leisure by 0.06
12: clean; restores hygiene by 0.06
13: rest_alone; restores leisure by 0.05
14: rest_with_others; restores social by 0.03, leisure by 0.03
15: explore; restores leisure by 0.03
16: move_up; restores 
17: move_down; restores 
18: move_left; restores 
19: move_right; restores
